title: Permit Expiry Risk by Trade
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:permit permit_name=* expiry_epoch=* permit_state=*
| eval days_left=round((expiry_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where permit_state="active"
| table permit_name trade permit_state days_left
| sort days_left
description: Lists open active permits with time remaining for permit compliance.
value: Time-left monitoring helps prevent quiet deadline misses across the operational details that support permit compliance.
implementation: Store an expiry timestamp on `reno:permit` events and filter for open or unfinished active permits.
visualization: Table of open active permits sorted by time remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which active permits are about to run out of time so you can deal with them before permit compliance slips.
